findings.title: buildEnvelope duplicated in governor.ts
findings.disposition_rationale: Faithful copy (same field set/order; signatures use order-independent canonicalBytes so drift cannot break signing). Hoisting a shared envelope builder recorded as a follow-up (discovered scope).

findings.title: Spec did not note admissions are dropped on restart
findings.disposition_rationale: Added a spec note: in-memory admissions are dropped on restart; authorize then returns producer-not-admitted (fail-closed, idempotent re-admit). Commit on branch.

findings.title: Spec section 4.10 overclaimed cross-rotate verification
findings.disposition_rationale: Corrected section 4.10: producer-HMAC records re-verify (root unchanged) but commissaire-signed prior-key records fail chain-invalid across a rotate; prior-key breadth is the verifier's job (FAFF-1178). Commit on branch.
